description: Tako 2.4.1 on hyper and Tokio, default configuration. Plain HTTP/1.1 and WebSocket on :8080 run tako's per-thread server (one current-thread runtime per CPU, SO_REUSEPORT listeners, PerThreadConfig::default()); h2c (:8082), HTTP/1.1 and h2 over rustls (:8081, :8443) and HTTP/3 over quinn (:8443/udp) run tako's multi-thread Server. Routing, Path/Query/State/body extractors and the Json responder through the tako API, the compression plugin with default settings on the JSON routes, ServeDir with precompressed .br/.gz sidecars read from disk per request, TakoWs for /ws, and deadpool-postgres for async-db.
